name: ceo-inbox-sent-observe
description: Poll the principal's Sent folder since a stored watermark, match new sends to Curia draft snapshots and open owner=ceo tasks, append evidence to OKF, and advance the watermark. Read-only against Nylas; never drafts, archives, or sends. Intended for the daily ceo-inbox sent-observe cron — do not fold into triage.

inputs.force: boolean? (when true, ignore the idle backoff gate — tests / manual runs)

outputs.shadow_judge_failed: number (shadow pairs whose judge chunk returned an unusable response; they retry next run)
outputs.shadow_deferred: number (shadow pairs past the per-run judge limit; they retry next run)
outputs.shadow_fetch_failed: number (shadow pairs whose sent body could not be fetched; they retry next run)
outputs.shadow_record_failed: number (judged shadow pairs whose row insert or reconciled mark failed; they retry next run)
outputs.watermark_held: boolean (true when this run saw mail but kept the watermark so the same mail is re-observed next run)
outputs.backfill_active: boolean (true when an oldest-first backlog drain is still underway after this run — the watermark stays pinned to its floor until the drain completes)
outputs.tasks_truncated: boolean (true when the open principal-task set exceeded the pagination safety ceiling, so task-completion matching ran against a partial set)
